evidence: This is a terrain ground patch (4x3 tiles) seen entirely as a horizontal surface, which is standard and expected for ground terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate is a single 16x16 sand tile repeated identically across all 12 tiles of the 4x3 patch, using 4 sand tones (base tan, light tan, cream highlight, dark tan shadow) with very sparse diagonal lines and dots and large areas of flat base fill. By contrast, the Beodeul grass and paving references use multiple tile variations across the 4x3 grid and denser organic speckle/cobble patterning.
